passages.text: Was the same.22-caliber firearm used against Michael, Mary and Jennifer?
How was Jennifer transported into North Carolina?
Why was the specific Grogan Road/Stoneville area chosen?
Did the offender have a connection to Rockingham County?
Did the offender know both the Short residence and Jennifer’s disposal site?
Was there one killer or more than one?
Was the motive related to Jennifer, Michael’s business, a personal grievance, or something investigators have not publicly revealed?
Does evidence preserved since 2002 contain the killer’s DNA?
Has modern testing produced a viable unknown DNA profile?
Can current genetic technology finally identify the person responsible?
The Short family case remains active: Virginia State Police continues to list the investigation as active. Virginia Cold Case Database
Victims: Michael Wayne Short, Mary Hall Short, and Jennifer Renee Short are all homicide victims. Their killer or killers remain unidentified.
An investigator assigned by the Henry County Sheriff’s Office works the case nearly daily.
Virginia State Police and FBI personnel continue assisting.
Evidence collected in 2002 has undergone renewed advanced DNA testing.

Authorities continue seeking people who had contact with the family during the two weeks immediately preceding the murders and people connected to Michael’s mobile-home business or South Carolina trips.
No person has been charged with killing Michael, Mary or Jennifer Short.
